title: NHDF v0.3 general-purpose continuous collision detection profile

kernel_stage_mapping.C_in_E_LP_A_B_X_xi_B0_P_C_phi_R_BST_K_T: base NHDF conditioning, addressing, zero-set, predicates, routing, and motion
kernel_stage_mapping.B_CCD_D_CCD_T_TOI_M_C_R_C: optional CCD candidate, dispatch, certified event, manifold, and response stages

mappings.typed: NHDF/PCKF/IHCP plus typed CCD query and certificate records
mappings.vector: body motion, contact witnesses, normals, relative velocity
mappings.kinematic: forward trajectories and declared numerical integration
mappings.geometry: implicit fields, conservative bounds, candidate pairs, contact manifolds
mappings.topology: base chart/orientation semantics; topology does not replace collision certificates
mappings.packing: base log-polar LUT may prioritize or index but does not replace geometry
mappings.predicate: exact, inclusion, interval, or controlled conservative event certificate
mappings.operator: CCD stages compose inside the surrounding NHDF chain
mappings.self_reference: contact output and residual enter explicit next-generation U/H update
